description: Key facts a correct lesson on each Strength of Materials topic must state. Every fact was taken from the fetched text of the source page named with it (the quote is checked by `npm run golden:check`). Patterns are case-insensitive regular expressions matched against the lesson text after LaTeX backslashes and braces are removed.
subject: strength-of-materials

source.quote: The greater the force and the smaller the cross-sectional area of the body on which it acts, the greater the stress

facts.claim: Mohr's circle is a graphical transformation of stress

source.quote: Mohr's circle is a two-dimensional graphical representation of the transformation law for the Cauchy stress tensor

facts.claim: It finds principal planes and principal stresses

source.quote: Mohr's circle can also be used to find the principal planes and the principal stresses

facts.claim: Restrained thermal expansion or contraction causes stress

source.quote: thermal stress is mechanical stress created by any change in temperature of a material

facts.claim: Depends on the coefficient of thermal expansion

source.quote: This type of stress is highly dependent on the thermal expansion coefficient

facts.claim: SFD/BMD give shear force and bending moment along the beam for design

source.quote: Shear force and bending moment diagrams are analytical tools used in conjunction with structural analysis

facts.claim: Stress is zero at the neutral axis and largest at the extreme fibres

source.quote: the maximum stress experienced in the section (at the furthest points from the neutral axis of the beam)

facts.claim: Bending: a slender member loaded perpendicular to its axis

source.quote: a slender structural element subjected to an external load applied perpendicularly to a longitudinal axis

facts.claim: Deflection is found by integrating the slope (curvature) equation

source.quote: The deflection distance of a member under a load can be calculated by integrating the function that mathematically describes the slope
Use of Macaulay's technique is very convenient for cases of discontinuous and/or discrete loading

facts.claim: Torsion: twisting by an applied torque, producing shear stress

source.quote: torsion is the twisting of an object caused by an applied torque

facts.claim: Torsional stress is a shear stress

source.quote: the resulting torsional shear stress is expressed in pascals

facts.claim: The wire of a coil spring is in torsion

source.quote: Under tension or compression, the material (wire) of a coil spring undergoes torsion
is used to store energy and subsequently release it

facts.claim: Euler's critical load is the largest axial load a slender column carries without buckling

source.quote: the maximum axial load that a long, slender, ideal column can carry without buckling
circumferential stress, or hoop stress, a normal stress in the tangential (azimuth) direction

facts.claim: Radial stress is negligible in thin walls

source.quote: Thin sections often have negligibly small radial stress

facts.claim: Displacement = partial derivative of strain energy with respect to force

source.quote: is a method for determining the displacements of a linear-elastic system based on the partial derivatives of the energy
